[SWS_PHM_01115]
{OBSOLETE}
Generated header files for
Health Channels
⌈
The
Platform Health Management
shall provide one
Health Channel
header
file
for each
HealthChannel
defined in the input by using the file name
<name>.h
,
where
<name>
is the
HealthChannel
.
shortName
⌋
(RS_PHM_00001)
So effectively, for each
Health Channel
, there is a separate generated file. There
can be several
Health Channels
in the same namespace, which results with several
files in the same folder.
8.2 API Common Data Types
This chapter describes the standardized types provided by the
ara::phm
API. The
ara::phm
API is based on the
ara::core
types defined in [8].
